```{r}
# IDENTIFIER VARIABLES
identifier_vars <- c("Wave", "Country", "Year")

# OUTCOME VARIABLES 
outcome_vars <- setdiff(grep("^C", names(VC), value = TRUE), "Country")

# PREDICTOR VARIABLES 
predictor_vars <- setdiff(names(VC), c(identifier_vars, outcome_vars))
# Numeric predictor variables 
predictor_num_vars <- predictor_vars[
  sapply(VC[predictor_vars], is.numeric) &
  !(predictor_vars %in% c("Country", "Year", "Wave"))
]
num_cols <- names(VC)[sapply(VC, is.numeric)]

```

```{r}

# Create plotting table

  Variable = names(zero_count),
  Zero_Count = as.numeric(zero_count),
  Type = ifelse(names(zero_count) %in% outcome_vars,
                "Confidence (Outcome)",
                "Predictor")
)

                 aes(x = reorder(Variable, Zero_Count),
                     y = Zero_Count,
                     fill = Type)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(

       x = "Variable",
       y = "Count of Zero",
       fill = "Variable Type") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

print(p_zero)
```

```{r}
# numeric_cols <- sapply(VC, is.numeric)

# NEGATIVE -> NA 
VC[num_cols] <- lapply(VC[num_cols], function(x) replace(x, x < 0, NA))

# INVALID 0s -> NA 
valid_zero <- c(
  grep("^ACT", names(VC), value = TRUE),
  grep("^ICQ", names(VC), value = TRUE)
)
zero_invalid_vars <- setdiff(num_cols, valid_zero)
VC[zero_invalid_vars] <- lapply(VC[zero_invalid_vars], function(x) {
  x[x == 0] <- NA
  x
})
```

```{r}
# TABLE: WELCH T-TESTS
q2a_results <- map_dfr(predictor_q2a, function(var){

  x <- VC_focus[[var]]
  y <- VC_other[[var]]

  test <- t.test(x, y, var.equal = FALSE)

  tibble(
    Variable = var,
    Focus_Mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Focus_SD = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Other_Mean = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE),
    Other_SD = sd(y, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Diff = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE),
    P_Value = test$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Mean_Diff)))

knitr::kable(q2a_results, digits = 3)
write.csv(q2a_results, "q2a_welch_ttest_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# TABLE: Top significant mean differences (clean for report)

q2a_summary <- q2a_results %>%
```

# Q2b
```{r}
predictor_q2b <- predictor_q2a
confidence_vars <- outcome_vars
```

```{r}
# Run stepwise and forward models
run_models_selection <- function(data, predictors, outcomes) {
  
  model_list <- lapply(outcomes, function(out) {
    
    # Keep only needed columns for this outcome
    model_data <- data %>%
      dplyr::select(all_of(c(out, predictors))) %>%
      na.omit()
    
    # Standardise variables so coefficients are comparable
    model_data <- model_data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(scale(.))))
    
    full_formula <- as.formula(
      paste(out, "~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))
    )
    
    null_formula <- as.formula(
      paste(out, "~ 1")
    )
    
    full_model <- lm(full_formula, data = model_data)
    null_model <- lm(null_formula, data = model_data)
    
    step_model <- stepAIC(
      full_model,
      direction = "both",
      trace = FALSE
    )
    
    forward_model <- stepAIC(
      null_model,
      scope = list(lower = null_formula, upper = full_formula),
      direction = "forward",
      trace = FALSE
    )
    
    list(
      stepwise = step_model,
      forward = forward_model,
      n = nrow(model_data)
    )
  })
  
  names(model_list) <- outcomes
  return(model_list)
}

# Model performance table
get_model_perf <- function(model_list) {
  
  bind_rows(lapply(names(model_list), function(out) {
    
    step_sum <- summary(model_list[[out]]$stepwise)
    fwd_sum  <- summary(model_list[[out]]$forward)
    
    step_p <- pf(
      step_sum$fstatistic[1],
      step_sum$fstatistic[2],
      step_sum$fstatistic[3],
      lower.tail = FALSE
    )
    
    fwd_p <- pf(
      fwd_sum$fstatistic[1],
      fwd_sum$fstatistic[2],
      fwd_sum$fstatistic[3],
      lower.tail = FALSE
    )
    
    tibble(
      Outcome = out,
      N = model_list[[out]]$n,
      Stepwise_R2 = step_sum$r.squared,
      Stepwise_Adj_R2 = step_sum$adj.r.squared,
      Stepwise_Model_P = step_p,
      Forward_R2 = fwd_sum$r.squared,
      Forward_Adj_R2 = fwd_sum$adj.r.squared,
      Forward_Model_P = fwd_p
    )
  })) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Best_Method = ifelse(Stepwise_Adj_R2 >= Forward_Adj_R2, "Stepwise", "Forward"),
      Best_R2 = pmax(Stepwise_R2, Forward_R2),
      Best_Adj_R2 = pmax(Stepwise_Adj_R2, Forward_Adj_R2),
      Best_Model_P = ifelse(Best_Method == "Stepwise", Stepwise_Model_P, Forward_Model_P)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(Best_Adj_R2))
}

# Extract coefficients from best model
get_coefficients_best <- function(model_list, group_name) {
  
  bind_rows(lapply(names(model_list), function(out) {
    
    step_sum <- summary(model_list[[out]]$stepwise)
    fwd_sum  <- summary(model_list[[out]]$forward)
    
    best_model <- if (step_sum$adj.r.squared >= fwd_sum$adj.r.squared) {
      model_list[[out]]$stepwise
    } else {
      model_list[[out]]$forward
    }
    
    coef_df <- as.data.frame(summary(best_model)$coefficients)
    coef_df$Variable <- rownames(coef_df)
    coef_df$Outcome <- out
    coef_df$Group <- group_name
    coef_df$Significant <- coef_df$`Pr(>|t|)` < 0.05
    coef_df$Abs_t <- abs(coef_df$`t value`)
    coef_df$Abs_Beta <- abs(coef_df$Estimate)
    rownames(coef_df) <- NULL
    
    coef_df
  })) %>%
    dplyr::filter(Variable != "(Intercept)")
}

# Run models
models_focus <- run_models_selection(
  data = VC_focus,
  predictors = predictor_q2b,
  outcomes = confidence_vars
)
```

```{r}
# Assumption checks for the most reliably predicted outcome
best_outcome <- model_perf_focus %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = Best_Adj_R2, n = 1) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Outcome)

step_sum_best <- summary(models_focus[[best_outcome]]$stepwise)
fwd_sum_best  <- summary(models_focus[[best_outcome]]$forward)

best_model <- if (step_sum_best$adj.r.squared >= fwd_sum_best$adj.r.squared) {
  models_focus[[best_outcome]]$stepwise
} else {
  models_focus[[best_outcome]]$forward
}

cat("Most reliably predicted confidence outcome:", best_outcome, "\n")
cat("Selected model:",
    ifelse(step_sum_best$adj.r.squared >= fwd_sum_best$adj.r.squared,
           "Stepwise", "Forward"),
    "\n")

# Save diagnostics to file instead of tiny plotting pane
png("Q2b_assumption_checks.png", width = 1200, height = 1000, res = 120)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
plot(best_model)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
time_var <- "Wave"

VC_focus <- VC_focus %>%
  mutate(Wave = as.numeric(as.character(Wave)))

VC_other <- VC_other %>%
  mutate(Wave = as.numeric(as.character(Wave)))

# Create combined dataset 
combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  VC_focus %>% dplyr::mutate(Group = focus_country),
  VC_other %>% dplyr::mutate(Group = "Others")
)

# Correlation with Time (Wave) (Selection rule: |r| >= 0.05)
all_vars <- intersect(names(VC_focus), names(VC_other))
all_vars <- setdiff(all_vars, c("Country", "Wave", "Year"))

all_vars <- all_vars[
  sapply(VC_focus[, all_vars, drop = FALSE], is.numeric) &
  sapply(VC_other[, all_vars, drop = FALSE], is.numeric)
]

all_vars <- as.character(all_vars)

compute_time_cor <- function(data, vars, time_col) {
  sapply(vars, function(v) {
    if (!(v %in% names(data))) return(NA_real_)
    if (!(time_col %in% names(data))) return(NA_real_)
    
    d <- data[!is.na(data[[v]]) & !is.na(data[[time_col]]), , drop = FALSE]
    
    if (nrow(d) < 10) return(NA_real_)
    if (!is.numeric(d[[v]]) || !is.numeric(d[[time_col]])) return(NA_real_)
    
    cor(d[[time_col]], d[[v]], method = "pearson")
  })
}

focus_time_cor  <- compute_time_cor(VC_focus, all_vars, time_var)
others_time_cor <- compute_time_cor(VC_other, all_vars, time_var)

time_cor_df <- data.frame(
  Variable      = all_vars,
  Focus_r       = round(focus_time_cor, 3),
  Others_r      = round(others_time_cor, 3),
  Focus_select  = abs(focus_time_cor) >= 0.05,
  Others_select = abs(others_time_cor) >= 0.05
)

cat("\n=== Correlation screening with Wave ===\n")
print(time_cor_df, row.names = FALSE)

selected_vars <- time_cor_df$Variable[
  time_cor_df$Focus_select | time_cor_df$Others_select
]

cat("\nVariables selected for further analysis:\n")
cat(paste(selected_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")


# Optional neat table
knitr::kable(
  time_cor_df,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Screening variables by Pearson correlation with Wave"
)

write.csv(time_cor_df, "q3a_pearson_correlation_wave.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# TEST CHANGE OVER TIME WITHIN EACH GROUP
# If residual normality looks acceptable -> ANOVA
# Else -> Kruskal-Wallis
run_method1_test <- function(data, vars, group_name) {

  results <- lapply(vars, function(v) {

    d <- data %>%
      dplyr::select(Wave, all_of(v)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Wave), !is.na(.data[[v]]))

    # Must have enough observations and at least 2 waves
    if (nrow(d) < 10 || n_distinct(d$Wave) < 2) {
      return(data.frame(
        Group = group_name,
        Variable = v,
        Test = NA,
        Statistic = NA,
        P_Value = NA,
        Significant = NA
      ))
    }

    d$WaveFactor <- factor(d$Wave)

    # fit model for residual normality check
    lm_fit <- try(lm(as.formula(paste(v, "~ WaveFactor")), data = d), silent = TRUE)

    use_anova <- FALSE

    if (!inherits(lm_fit, "try-error")) {
      res <- residuals(lm_fit)

      # Shapiro only when feasible
      if (length(res) >= 3 && length(res) <= 5000) {
        shp <- try(shapiro.test(res), silent = TRUE)

        if (!inherits(shp, "try-error") && shp$p.value > 0.05) {
          use_anova <- TRUE
        }
      }
    }

    if (use_anova) {
      fit <- aov(as.formula(paste(v, "~ WaveFactor")), data = d)
      tab <- summary(fit)[[1]]

      data.frame(
        Group = group_name,
        Variable = v,
        Test = "ANOVA",
        Statistic = unname(tab$`F value`[1]),
        P_Value = unname(tab$`Pr(>F)`[1]),
        Significant = unname(tab$`Pr(>F)`[1]) < 0.05
      )

    } else {
      kw <- kruskal.test(as.formula(paste(v, "~ WaveFactor")), data = d)

      data.frame(
        Group = group_name,
        Variable = v,
        Test = "Kruskal-Wallis",
        Statistic = unname(kw$statistic),
        P_Value = unname(kw$p.value),
        Significant = unname(kw$p.value) < 0.05
      )
    }
  })

  bind_rows(results)
}

method1_focus <- run_method1_test(VC_focus, selected_vars, focus_country)
method1_other <- run_method1_test(VC_other, selected_vars, "Others")

method1_results <- bind_rows(method1_focus, method1_other) %>%
  arrange(Group, P_Value)
```

```{r}
# SUMMARY
get_direction_summary <- function(data, vars, group_name) {

  out <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
    d <- data %>%
      dplyr::select(Wave, all_of(v)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Wave), !is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
      group_by(Wave) %>%
      summarise(Mean = mean(.data[[v]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(Wave)

    if (nrow(d) < 2) {
      return(data.frame(
        Group = group_name,
        Variable = v,
        First_Wave_Mean = NA,
        Last_Wave_Mean = NA,
        Mean_Change = NA,
        Direction = NA
      ))
    }

    change <- d$Mean[nrow(d)] - d$Mean[1]

    direction <- ifelse(
      abs(change) < 0.05, "Stable",
      ifelse(change > 0, "Increasing", "Decreasing")
    )

    data.frame(
      Group = group_name,
      Variable = v,
      First_Wave_Mean = d$Mean[1],
      Last_Wave_Mean = d$Mean[nrow(d)],
      Mean_Change = change,
      Direction = direction
    )
  })

  bind_rows(out)
}

direction_focus <- get_direction_summary(VC_focus, selected_vars, focus_country)
direction_other <- get_direction_summary(VC_other, selected_vars, "Others")
direction_summary <- bind_rows(direction_focus, direction_other)
```

```{r}
# INTERACTION REGRESSION:
# Test whether trend over time differs between focus country and Others

combined2 <- combined %>%
  mutate(Group_dummy = ifelse(Group == focus_country, 1, 0))

interaction_results <- combined2 %>%
  dplyr::select(Wave, Group_dummy, all_of(selected_vars)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(selected_vars),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Variable) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~{
    fit <- lm(Value ~ Wave + Group_dummy + Wave:Group_dummy, data = .x)
    s <- summary(fit)

    coef_tab <- as.data.frame(s$coefficients)
    coef_tab$term <- rownames(coef_tab)
    rownames(coef_tab) <- NULL

    names(coef_tab) <- c("estimate", "std.error", "statistic", "p.value", "term")

    coef_tab %>%
      dplyr::filter(term == "Wave:Group_dummy") %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        Interaction_Effect = estimate,
        Interaction_P = p.value,
        Interaction_Significant = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "Yes", "No"),
        Trend_Comparison = case_when(
          p.value >= 0.05 ~ "No significant difference in trend",
          estimate > 0 ~ paste(focus_country, "changes more positively over time"),
          estimate < 0 ~ paste(focus_country, "changes more negatively over time")
        )
      )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

knitr::kable(
  interaction_results,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Interaction regression: does the trend over time differ between groups?"
)

write.csv(interaction_results, "q3a_interaction_regression.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Q3b
```{r}
# For each wave and each outcome:
# fit outcome ~ all predictors
# record adj R2
# identify strongest predictor by largest absolute t value

fit_models_by_wave <- function(data, predictors, outcomes, min_n = 30) {
  
  results_perf <- list()
  results_coef <- list()
  
  waves <- sort(unique(data$Wave))
  
  for (w in waves) {
    data_w <- data %>% dplyr::filter(Wave == w)
    
    for (outcome in outcomes) {
      
      needed_vars <- c(outcome, predictors)
      needed_vars <- needed_vars[needed_vars %in% names(data_w)]
      
      d <- data_w %>%
        dplyr::select(all_of(needed_vars)) %>%
        tidyr::drop_na()
      
      if (nrow(d) < min_n) next
      
      formula_txt <- paste(outcome, "~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))
      fit <- try(lm(as.formula(formula_txt), data = d), silent = TRUE)
      
      if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) next
      
      s <- summary(fit)
      
      # ----- model performance -----
      fstat <- s$fstatistic
      model_p <- if (!is.null(fstat)) {
        pf(fstat[1], fstat[2], fstat[3], lower.tail = FALSE)
      } else {
        NA
      }
      
      results_perf[[length(results_perf) + 1]] <- tibble(
        Wave = w,
        Outcome = outcome,
        N = nrow(d),
        R2 = s$r.squared,
        Adj_R2 = s$adj.r.squared,
        Model_P = model_p
      )
      
      # ----- coefficient table -----
      coef_tab <- as.data.frame(s$coefficients)
      coef_tab$term <- rownames(coef_tab)
      rownames(coef_tab) <- NULL
      
      names(coef_tab) <- c("estimate", "std.error", "statistic", "p.value", "term")
      
      coef_tab <- coef_tab %>%
        dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          Wave = w,
          Outcome = outcome,
          Abs_t = abs(statistic),
          Significant = p.value < 0.05
        )
      
      results_coef[[length(results_coef) + 1]] <- coef_tab
    }
  }
  
  list(
    performance = bind_rows(results_perf),
    coefficients = bind_rows(results_coef)
  )
}

models_focus <- fit_models_by_wave(VC_focus, predictor_vars, outcome_vars, min_n = 30)
models_other <- fit_models_by_wave(VC_other, predictor_vars, outcome_vars, min_n = 30)

model_perf_other <- models_other$performance %>% mutate(Group = "Other")

coef_focus <- models_focus$coefficients %>% mutate(Group = focus_country)
coef_other <- models_other$coefficients %>% mutate(Group = "Other")
```

```{r}
    coef_tab$term <- rownames(coef_tab)
    rownames(coef_tab) <- NULL
    
    names(coef_tab) <- c("estimate", "std.error", "statistic", "p.value", "term")
    
    coef_tab %>%
      dplyr::filter(term == "Wave") %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        Slope = estimate,
        Std_Error = std.error,
        T_Value = statistic,
        P_Value = p.value,
        Significant = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "Yes", "No")
      )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

trend_summary_report <- trend_test_results %>%
  mutate(
    Direction = case_when(
      Slope > 0 & Significant == "Yes" ~ "Increasing",
      Slope < 0 & Significant == "Yes" ~ "Decreasing",
      TRUE ~ "Stable / weak trend"
    )
  )

kable(trend_summary_report, digits = 4,
      caption = "Report-ready summary of time trends")

write.csv(trend_summary_report, "q3b_summary_time_trend.csv", row.names = FALSE)


predictive_summary_report <- model_perf_all %>%
  group_by(Group, Outcome) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Adj_R2 = mean(Adj_R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_Adj_R2 = max(Adj_R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min_Adj_R2 = min(Adj_R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Group, desc(Mean_Adj_R2))

kable(predictive_summary_report, digits = 4,
      caption = "Report-ready summary of predictive ability over time")

write.csv(predictive_summary_report, "q3b_summary_predictive.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
# model_perf_focus and model_perf_other should already exist
model_perf_all <- bind_rows(
  model_perf_focus %>% mutate(Group = focus_country),
  model_perf_other %>% mutate(Group = "Other")
)

# optional: keep only outcomes with enough data
plot_perf_data <- model_perf_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(Adj_R2))

ggplot(plot_perf_data,
       aes(x = Wave,
           y = Adj_R2,
           color = Outcome,
           group = Outcome)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Group) +
  labs(
    title = "Adjusted R² Values for Each Confidence Variable over Wave",
    x = "Wave",
    y = expression(Adjusted~R^2),
    color = "Confidence Variable"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
